1 APPLICATIONS 
 ‘DB’ pumps are used for cold and hot water and non - corrosive chemicals. 
 The fields of application of these pumps include w ater works for mechanically  
 Filtered wat

lude w ater works for mechanically  
 Filtered water, for circulation of water in air conditioning plants, textile mills, 
 Industrial plants, for pumping, screening water for paper and pulp mills, for 
 Lift irrigation schemes and agricultural purposes, in sugar industry for pumping    
 clear and weighted juice, with small fire fighting equipment etc. 
 
 
 For any other application, please refer to our sales head office .

 also having a support foot. Mounted pumps with the  bearing bracket also  
 having a support foot. These are centrifugal pumps  with e

 Impeller and are fitted with standard accessories.

‘DB’ pumps are directl

4.5.1 Direct drive  
 
‘DB’ pumps are directly driven by electric motor or engine. They use love- joy coupling L 
or C type of ample size as a standard arrangement. Other types of couplings can also be 
offered against specific requirement. 
 
4.5.2 Indirect drive  
 
 Indirect drive is possible either via flat or v belts drive (refer to our sales head 
office) 
 
4.5.3 Direction of rotation  
 
‘DB’ pumps are assembled for clockwise rotation whe n viewed from coupling end.

 ‘DB’ pumps can be used for liquid having viscosity  upto 500 SSU, However 
viscosity correction is to be applied for viscosity above 55 SSU.

ction is to be applied for viscosity above 55 SSU.
